$comment: ArchiDrive - pi-lens project config. The auxiliary Python scanner (pyright) resolves imports against the interpreter discovered from pyrightconfig.json (backend/.venv); without a root-level venv it fell back to system Python and flagged every third-party import as unresolved plus every SQLAlchemy string-annotation relationship as undefined - identical findings appear on untouched pre-existing files (models/project.py, migrations/002). Those rules carry zero signal here. Correctness is enforced by the backend pytest suite and frontend tsc, which use the real interpreter.
